title: Use lead scores to follow up
blurb: Find your hottest leads and act on them.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Manage Scoring
steps.body: Click **Manage Scoring** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Where scores show
steps.body: Each contact's score is saved on their record, so you can filter and sort by it.

steps.title: Make a hot list
steps.body: In **Contacts**, filter by score (for example above 50) and save it as a smart list to call first.

steps.title: Automate it
steps.body: In a workflow, use the score to alert you or assign the lead to a salesperson once it passes a number.
